serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Landlord: Good to see you Anon.
You: H-hi… What are you doing here?
Landlord: What am I doing here? Buying groceries of course! What else would I do here?
You: S-sorry, I didn’t see you.
Landlord: I was in another queue in the market, you blind fool!
You: I haven’t realised...
Landlord: So you really didn’t see me, huh. I wanted to reprimand you for not saying ‘good morning’ to me back in the shop, like a good tenant would do.
This prick…
Landlord: Well, I guess it can’t be helped then. Young people these days…
Oh man, can’t he just go away, he’s talking and talking.
Landlord: You got something else to do in the city?
You: No, I don’t think so.
Landlord: Then why aren’t we going back to my building?! Do you want me to just stand here?! In this cold?!
What is his deal? No one is stopping you from going!
You: Alright. Bye.
